_about: Question bank for generate_data.py. Analysts and native Hindi speakers extend this file, not the Python. Every phrase list is [English, Hindi (Devanagari), Hinglish (romanised)].
ranking_question: {t} {m} के हिसाब से टॉप {n} स्टोर कौन से थे?
{t} {m} ke hisaab se top {n} stores kaun se the?

q: How many distinct products were sold {t}?
{t} कितने अलग-अलग उत्पाद बिके?
{t} kitne alag products bike?
Which return reason was most common {t}?
{t} सबसे आम रिटर्न कारण क्या था?
{t} sabse common return reason kya tha?
long_tail.gold_sql: SELECT r.reason, COUNT(*) AS n FROM fct_returns AS r JOIN dim_store AS s ON r.store_sk = s.store_sk WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '{s}' AND DATE '{e}' AND s.store_id NOT LIKE 'TEST-%' GROUP BY r.reason ORDER BY n DESC, r.reason LIMIT 1

q: Top 5 SKUs by number of returns {t}?
{t} रिटर्न के हिसाब से टॉप 5 SKU कौन से थे?
{t} ke top 5 return wale SKU kaun se the?
long_tail.gold_sql: SELECT p.sku, COUNT(*) AS n FROM fct_returns AS r JOIN dim_product AS p ON r.product_id = p.product_id JOIN dim_store AS s ON r.store_sk = s.store_sk WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '{s}' AND DATE '{e}' AND s.store_id NOT LIKE 'TEST-%' GROUP BY p.sku ORDER BY n DESC, p.sku LIMIT 5

q: How many bills were above Rs 1,000 {t}?
{t} 1,000 रुपये से ऊपर के कितने बिल थे?
{t} 1000 rupaye se upar ke kitne bill the?
long_tail.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM (SELECT f.bill_id {where} GROUP BY f.bill_id HAVING SUM(f.gross_amount) > 1000) AS b

q: How many voided lines were there {t}?
{t} कितनी लाइनें वॉयड हुईं?
{t} kitni void lines thi?
long_tail.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n {where} AND f.qty < 0

q: What was the average number of lines per bill {t}?
{t} प्रति बिल औसत लाइनें कितनी थीं?
{t} per bill average lines kitni thi?
long_tail.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(*) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT f.bill_id), 4) AS v {where}
